trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for EDUCATION.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- admissions_enquiry: Check eligibility against real criteria, report seat availability and progress an application.
- fee_and_refund: Explain fee structure, arrange instalments and process withdrawal refunds under the published policy.

Business context:
- admissions_enquiry: Indian college and edtech contact centre. Callers ask about eligibility, seats, fees and refunds. Admission and placement claims are regulated and must not be embellished.
- fee_and_refund: Indian college and edtech contact centre. Callers ask about eligibility, seats, fees and refunds. Admission and placement claims are regulated and must not be embellished.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [admissions_enquiry]
  - Criteria truth: Eligibility may only be stated from check_course_eligibility, never estimated from marks.
  - No admission promise: Submitting an application is not admission. The agent must not imply a seat is secured.
  - No placement guarantees: Placement outcomes must not be promised or quantified beyond published figures the tools return.
  - Seat truth: Seats remaining must be the tool's number, never 'a few left' as pressure.
  [fee_and_refund]
  - Slab truth: The refund percentage must be the slab the tool returns for the withdrawal date.
  - Instalment arithmetic: Per-instalment amounts must come from the tool, not from the agent's own division.
  - Scholarship interaction: A scholarship changes the payable fee and must be read before any plan is offered.
  - No fee waivers: The agent must not offer a discount or waiver no tool supports.

Tools available to you (7): check_course_eligibility, check_refund_slab, lookup_applicant, lookup_fee_account, setup_instalment_plan, submit_application, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: mr-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_course_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply a course's published criteria to an applicant's record.

model_visible_tools.name: check_refund_slab
model_visible_tools.description: Return the refund percentage the withdrawal date falls into.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_applicant
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve an applicant's qualification, marks and application state.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_fee_account
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve fees due, paid, instalment plan and the refund slab that applies.

model_visible_tools.name: setup_instalment_plan
model_visible_tools.description: Convert an outstanding fee into scheduled instalments.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_application
model_visible_tools.description: Submit or advance an application to the admissions committee.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Says at the outset how little time they have.
Interrupts a long explanation to ask for the outcome.
Accepts a callback rather than waiting.
Will not sit through an options list.

steps.purpose: Greet and state the purpose of the call.
steps.text: नमस्कार, मी college कडून बोलत आहे. मी APP-2009 च्या account holder सोबत बोलत आहे का?

steps.purpose: Acknowledge and ask for the reason.
steps.text: हो, मीच बोलतोय. काय काम होतं?

steps.purpose: Directly state the reason for the call.
steps.text: तुमचा fee instalment overdue आहे, त्याबद्दल call केला होता.

steps.purpose: Express time pressure and ask to be quick.
steps.text: अरे यार, माझी दोन मिनिटांत meeting आहे. fast बोला काय आहे, वेळ नाहीये.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the customer's time pressure and quickly move to verification.
steps.text: समजलं. मला फक्त तुमची identity verify करायची आहे. तुम्ही तुमचा registered pincode सांगू शकता का?

steps.purpose: Provide the requested verification factor.
Verify the customer's identity using the provided pincode.
Return the identity verification outcome.
Acknowledge successful verification and prepare to check the fee account.
steps.text: धन्यवाद. मी तुमची exact pending amount check करतो, एक मिनिट द्या.

steps.purpose: Call the lookup_fee_account tool to get the overdue amount.
Return incomplete fee account details to simulate a malformed response.
Recognize the malformed data, do not read it out, and inform the customer of a system issue.
steps.text: System मध्ये थोडा issue आहे, details पूर्ण आले नाहीत. Let me check again quickly.

steps.purpose: Retry the lookup_fee_account tool to get valid data.
Return the complete and correct fee account details.
State the pending amount exactly as returned by the tool and offer valid EMI options.
steps.text: तुमची pending amount 125000 आहे. आपण हे 2, 3 किंवा 4 EMI options मध्ये restructure करू शकतो. तुम्हाला किती instalments मध्ये करायचं आहे?

steps.purpose: Choose the 2-instalment option with a sense of urgency.
steps.text: दोन EMI मध्ये करा. पण लवकर करा.

steps.purpose: Correctly infer the intended number of instalments despite the STT error.
steps.text: ठीक आहे, मी 2 instalments चा plan set करतो. कृपया थोडा वेळ hold करा.

steps.purpose: Call the setup_instalment_plan tool with the requested 2 instalments.
Return the active instalment plan details.
State the per-instalment amount exactly as returned by the tool without inventing figures.
steps.text: तुमचा plan active झाला आहे. तुम्हाला 62500 चे 2 instalments pay करावे लागतील.

ir.terminal_condition: Instalment plan active with the per-instalment amount stated from the result.

variant_findings.reason: The tool returns incomplete data in e11. The agent correctly identifies the issue in e12, does not read out the partial data, and retries the tool in e13.
variant_findings.label: Error Resolution > Action Failure Recovery > Invalid Tool Response

variant_findings.reason: The agent violates the negative constraint of the variant by making an unsupported forward guarantee in e20 ('तुम्हाला लवकरच payment link मिळेल.' / 'You will receive a payment link soon'), which is not supported by any tool output.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

issues.detail: In e20, the agent promises the customer that they will receive a payment link soon. This violates the Tool Output Grounding variant, which explicitly forbids unsupported forward guarantees about what happens after the call ends.
issues.repair_instruction: Remove the promise of a payment link from the agent's utterance in e20. The agent should only confirm that the plan is active and state the per-instalment amount based on the tool result.

verification.summary: The conversation successfully demonstrates handling an incomplete tool response by retrying the action. However, it fails the Tool Output Grounding variant because the agent makes an unsupported promise about sending a payment link at the end of the call, violating the strict negative constraint against forward guarantees.

variant_findings.reason: The tool returns incomplete data in e11. The agent correctly recognizes the issue, refrains from presenting the partial data to the user, and immediately retries the tool call in e12 and e13.
variant_findings.label: Error Resolution > Action Failure Recovery > Invalid Tool Response

variant_findings.reason: The agent grounds all numerical claims strictly in the tool outputs, accurately stating the 125000 pending amount from e14 and the 62500 per-instalment amount from e19 without inventing any figures.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding
